commitResults.messageBody:
The task manager lacks a package structure and uses inconsistent naming,
boxed booleans, and undocumented public APIs. These issues make the code
harder to read and inconsistent with the project coding standard.

Move the classes into the ernest package and apply consistent naming,
encapsulation, formatting, and Javadocs. Use primitive boolean state with
boolean-style accessors to make task completion explicit.

Git changes need a consistent format for readable history and safe
collaboration.

Add the project Git skill and mandate imperative subjects, wrapped
WHAT/WHY bodies, and meaningful kebab-case branch names in AGENTS.md.

Java code needs a shared style guide to keep the student project
consistent and readable.

Add the project Java skill and mandate its package, naming, formatting,
encapsulation, and Javadoc rules in AGENTS.md.

commitResults.messageTitle: Tasks: Add support for ToDo, Deadline and Event tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce typed task classes and a TaskList to create, display, mark, and unmark tasks through Ernest's command loop. Parse deadline and event details from /by, /from, and /to fields.

Add a reusable Java 25 runner that executes isolated Ernest CLI sessions, compares complete console output, prints transcripts, and stops on the first failure.\n\nRecord representative todo, deadline, event, marking, exit, and invalid-command cases in the UI test plan, and require agents to review the plan and invoke the skill after code updates.

Keep addTask focused on capacity checks, list updates, and user output. Move deadline, event, and to-do parsing into dedicated helpers so each method has a single level of abstraction and marker positions are calculated once. This makes the command parser easier to read and maintain without changing its observable behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Derive Task Status From Completion State
commitResults.messageBody: Remove the duplicated status field from Task and derive the display marker directly from isDone. A single source of truth prevents the stored status and completion flag from drifting out of sync, while preserving the existing task output for incomplete and completed tasks.

Use a shared task lookup helper and guard clauses in markTask and unmarkTask. Invalid task numbers and already-set states now exit immediately, leaving the successful state transition unindented and reducing duplicated validation flow without changing console behavior.

Add reader-facing Javadocs for the task subtype classes, TaskList, and the TaskList constructor and fields. Document the private parsing helpers as well because their command formats and lookup behavior are not fully obvious. This records the purpose and contract of the existing code without changing runtime behavior.

Name the supported command prefixes and task detail markers, then use their lengths instead of unexplained substring offsets. This makes the parser easier to read and maintain while preserving the existing task descriptions, dates, time ranges, and console output for supported commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use Java Naming For Event Durations
commitResults.messageBody: Rename Event's duration_start and duration_end fields and constructor parameters to durationStart and durationEnd. The new names follow Java camelCase conventions and make the event model consistent with the rest of the code, without changing task formatting or behavior.

Make Deadline's due date and Event's time-range fields private and final. These values are set only during construction, so preventing subclass and external mutation protects each task's invariants while preserving the existing string representation and command-line behavior.

Make the no-argument Task constructor delegate to the description constructor so the shared incomplete-state initialization has one implementation. Keep taskName mutable because future task-editing behavior may need to update it; this refactoring only removes duplicated setup and preserves the existing constructors and output.

Rename the private Deadline field and constructor parameter from by to dueDate. The command syntax still uses by, but the model field now names the concept it stores, making the code easier to understand without changing the external task representation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate Command Processing From Input Loop
commitResults.messageBody: Keep runChat focused on reading input and controlling the chat lifecycle by moving command normalization, dispatch, and response output into processCommand. The boolean result preserves the existing exit behavior for bye while keeping command-specific logic at one abstraction level.

Guard task creation against missing or misordered deadline and event markers before substring parsing. Without these checks, malformed commands pass invalid indexes to substring and terminate the chatbot with an exception. Report the existing invalid-command message instead and cover both cases in the exact UI test plan.

Bring the code-quality refactorings and malformed-command handling onto master from the branch rooted at 6b19612. Preserve the branch history so the iterative changes remain independently reviewable while master receives the verified final state.
